name: curi-video
description: Remotion project that renders the Curi walkthrough from ../storyboard.json and ../screenshots. Separate from the app.

scripts.dev: npm run sync && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run sync && remotion render src/index.ts Walkthrough out/curi-walkthrough.mp4
scripts.render:vertical: npm run sync && remotion render src/index.ts WalkthroughVertical out/curi-walkthrough-9x16.mp4
scripts.still: npm run sync && remotion still src/index.ts Walkthrough out/frame.png --frame=2400
